subject: Exec concession request: 30% Hosted API unit discount for CuraTech expansion
messages:

Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Redwood - pilot to expansion: pricing question

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning — the engineering and product teams liked the latency profiles and the cost modeling. We want to convert the pilot into a paid annual commitment but need a better unit rate to justify cross-product rollout across EU and UK customers. Our CFO is asking whether Redwood can do a 30% unit discount on Hosted API usage if we commit to a 12-month, $450,000 committed spend.

If you can get commercial terms close to that we'll sign the SOW and aim to onboard devs in August. Attached is the latest call pattern spreadsheet.

Best,
Emma
Head of Product, CuraTech

Emma — appreciate the clear ask and the spend signal. I'm looping in Marissa from Deal Desk to confirm allowable concessions and whether exec sign-off is required for a 30% discount. Marissa — can you advise on the maximum AE-approved discount and whether Rishi or Lauren should be asked for one-off approval? Also flag if Legal/Privacy needs to scope a data residency addendum for EU-only storage. Need guidance on SLA expectations and operational onboarding timeline.

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 13:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood - pilot to expansion: pricing question

Couple of Deal Desk notes: CuraTech is a clean logo, good expansion profile in healthtech, and aligned with our EU capacity. Our standard Hosted API discount cap for AE signoff is 20%. Anything above requires executive approval because of margin impact and precedent risk.

I've sketched two concession structures for consideration: 
1) Time-limited concession: 30% off unit price for first 9 months, then revert to 15% for the remaining 3 months;
2) Milestone-linked concession: 30% off with a mandatory $450k minimum commit and quarterly usage milestones (failure to hit milestones re-prices to 15% going forward).

Both include a 12-week pilot acceptance, an SLA addendum with 99.9% target for inference latency, and a 30-day termination right if SLA materially missed. Attaching the proposed quote and MOP terms.

Attachments: CuraTech-quote-v3.pdf, MOP-terms-CuraTech.docx

Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Deal Desk, Redwood Inference

P.S. Rishi — I've added a quick margin-impact slide to the Drive link. Need exec decision by 7/20 to keep their onboarding window intact.

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 10:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood - pilot to expansion: pricing question

Thanks team. Quick read: the economics at 30% materially reduce gross margin on Hosted API units in EU; however, the customer does present expansion and reference potential. Two asks before I can approve a full 30% concession:
1) Finance to confirm incremental margin and payback (Marissa, please paste the calc here or link the sheet).
2) Legal to confirm whether data residency addendum increases delivery cost or engineering effort.

If finance/legal clear: I would be open to a one-time 30% concession under strict guardrails: 12-month contract, $450k minimum committed spend, milestone gates every quarter, and a limited 30% period (first 6 months) reverting to 15% afterward. That reduces downside while still giving CuraTech the commercial signal they want. Also require that this concession be documented as a single-use executive concession and not visible as a standard price band.

Can Markus or Lauren confirm operational impact and sign-off timeline? We need an answer to the customer by COB 7/20 to avoid losing the August onboarding target.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance_ops <finance@redwood.ai>, legal_ops <legal@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 09:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood - pilot to expansion: pricing question

I've reviewed Marissa's proposal and Rishi's conditions. Approving a one-time 30% Hosted API unit concession with the following mandatory conditions: 
- 12-month agreement with $450,000 minimum committed spend (upfront or ACH schedule to be agreed with Finance).
- 30% unit price for first 6 months, automatic reprice to 15% for months 7-12 if milestones met; otherwise reprice immediately.
- Quarterly usage milestones defined in SOW; failure to meet a milestone triggers reprice/repayment clause.
- Required SLA addendum for EU data residency and target latency; Legal to sign off on any MSA amendment.
- This is a documented, single-use executive concession and must not be quoted as a standard discount.

Marissa/Finance: please prepare the final quote and payment schedule. Legal: please review the MOP-terms and provide any redlines by EOD 7/21 so we can finalize with the customer. Soojin: you can communicate this conditional approval to Emma and request acceptance by 7/23 to preserve the onboarding window.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference

CC: finance@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai
